title: Proya Cosmetics adds an R&D lab to its European Innovation Centre
summary: Following the establishment of its European Innovation Center in France in 2024, Chinese cosmetics giant Proya inaugurated a new R&D laboratory in Suresnes, near Paris, on October 13, 2026. According to Proya Cosmetics, the new French laboratory will complement the work of the company's three R&D and innovation centres.
